action: Independent tester for scur-1, scur-2, scur-3, scur-5. Build the bee binary (cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml) and drive it against a throwaway onboarded sandbox under .bee/tmp (the verify-app skill shows how): set curator.enabled true with bee config set, add one capture stub with bee capture add, run bee upkeep due --kind curator --json (expect due true, reason capture_queue, exit 10), run bee audit log --kind curator-run --feature curator --note "clean — test", run it again (expect due false, info cadence_not_elapsed, exit 0), and run bee deferred-queue complete --help --brief (expect flags). Read skills/bee-curating/SKILL.md against CONTEXT.md D3. Compare the scur-1 tests against the contract decision upkeep-curator-due; add any missing behavior test to the upkeep_group tests module. Write the commands, outputs and verdict to docs/history/scheduled-curator/test-report.md. Report a defect instead of fixing production code. No code comments. Proof: the cell verify plus the sandbox run; quote both.
